question: Which festival of Kerala has entered the Guinness World Records for being the single largest gathering of women for a religious activity?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Attukal Pongala**__.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__
 __ 
• **Attukal Pongala** is a famous festival celebrated in the state of **Kerala**, India. It is organized annually at the **Attukal Bhagavathy Temple** in Thiruvananthapuram. 
• The festival is renowned for its unique feature of being the **largest single gathering of women** in the world for a religious activity. This achievement has been recognized by the **Guinness World Records**. 
• The event involves thousands of women preparing a special offering called **Pongala**, made of rice, jaggery, and coconut, which is cooked in earthen pots as an offering to the goddess Attukal Devi. 
• The festival spans over ten days, with the **Pongala ritual** being the most significant and occurring on the ninth day. Women gather in and around the temple premises and on the streets of Thiruvananthapuram to participate in this ritual. 
• The festival is a symbolic representation of **devotion, equality, and empowerment of women**, as it unites women from all walks of life and religious backgrounds. 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
 __ 
• **Significance of Attukal Pongala:** 
• The festival is dedicated to **Attukal Bhagavathy**, an incarnation of the Hindu goddess **Kannaki (Parvati).** 
• It is celebrated in the **Malayalam month of Kumbham** (February–March). 
• The festival represents the victory of good over evil and celebrates the **goddess’s power** to protect her devotees. 
• **Guinness World Records Recognition:** 
• The **2016 edition** of Attukal Pongala saw participation from more than **2.5 million women**, earning it the Guinness World Record for the **largest gathering of women** for a religious activity. 
• The record highlights the global cultural significance of the festival and its ability to bring women together in solidarity. 
• **Preparation for the Ritual:** 
• Women bring their own cooking utensils, ingredients, and firewood to prepare the Pongala offering on temporary hearths set up on roadsides and open spaces. 
• The ritual begins after the chief priest of the temple lights the **holy hearth (Pandara Aduppu)** inside the temple premises. 
• **Comparison with Other Kerala Festivals:** 
• **Chikalkalo:** A traditional mud festival celebrated in certain parts of Kerala, particularly in the Kasaragod district. It involves physical games and is not religious in nature. 
• **Pooram:** A temple festival celebrated with grand processions and fireworks. The most famous is the Thrissur Pooram. 
• **Vishu:** The Malayalam New Year celebrated in April, marked by feasting and the Vishukkani ritual. 
• **Attukal Pongala:** Stands out as a festival exclusively for women and holds spiritual and cultural importance. 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**
 
• **Historical Background:** The temple is believed to be over **500 years old** and holds a significant place in Kerala's religious and cultural history. 
• **Equality and Inclusiveness:** Women from all castes, religions, and social backgrounds participate in the festival, making it a symbol of **unity and empowerment.** 
• **Economic Impact:** The festival contributes significantly to the local economy, as vendors sell cooking materials, food items, and earthen pots during the event.
